title: Design System: El Ancón de Loíza

display.purpose: The year on the era dip. Archivo 900 at 66% width, fixed digit cells.

headline.purpose: The era year bottom left; also the board header year (34px), fact numerals (22px) and load card year.

title.purpose: Era name, in the reading voice at weight 700.

body.purpose: Fact text on the cream board, max 62ch.

meta.purpose: Source lines and notes on the board (13px); map credit (11px).

label.purpose: Placards and menu items: uppercase sign voice at 82% width. Small labels use 84% width at 12–13px.

stop.purpose: Year labels on the route line: 800 at 72% width, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: placard
shadows.purpose: Inner keyline plus a hard edge and a tight drop under every green placard.

shadows.name: placard-pressed
shadows.purpose: Keyline only; a pressed placard has no drop shadow.

shadows.name: placard-facts-open
shadows.purpose: Facts placard while the board is open.

shadows.name: marker
shadows.purpose: Dark ring so the gold route marker reads on any sky.

shadows.name: sign
shadows.purpose: Filter on the station sign image.

shadows.name: year
shadows.purpose: Text shadow on the era year over the scene.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Standard easing (--ease) for settle, rise, marker moves and the board.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.purpose: The route line drawing itself on arrival (1400ms, delay 200ms).

motion.name: settle-press
motion.purpose: A placard or stop that becomes chosen lifts and settles; colour cuts.

motion.name: placard-in
motion.purpose: A placard or menu that appears.

motion.name: arrival-settle
motion.value: 900ms var(--ease), from opacity 0 translateY(-10px); sign delay 150ms, utility placards 300ms
motion.purpose: Top objects settle once the scene is ready.

motion.name: arrival-rise
motion.value: 900ms var(--ease), from opacity 0 translateY(12px); era words 650ms, action placards 700ms

motion.name: cell-up
motion.purpose: Year digits rise inside their fixed cells on arrival and on each era change.

motion.name: stop-in
motion.purpose: Each route stop lands as the drawn line reaches it (x = position 0–1).

motion.name: marker-move
motion.purpose: Route marker and progress line travel to the chosen stop; none while dragged.

motion.name: era-dip
motion.value: close 300ms, hold until 2 frames (cap 1000ms), open 300ms; clip-path inset from top and bottom, smoothstep
motion.purpose: Two green leaves close on the horizon and open on the new era.

motion.name: year-count
motion.purpose: The dip year counts through the years between the two eras.

motion.name: board-in
motion.value: 420ms var(--ease), from opacity 0 translateX(28px); narrow: translateY(24px)

motion.name: fact-in
motion.value: 520ms var(--ease), from opacity 0 translateY(10px), delay 90ms + i × 55ms
motion.purpose: Facts follow the board in order.

motion.name: idle-fade
motion.value: after 7000ms still: opacity 0 over 1400ms; wake: 320ms ease
motion.purpose: Placards step back on mouse devices; not while hovered, focused, or with the board or menu open.

motion.name: drag-hint
motion.value: delay 3200ms, in 600ms, stay 7000ms, out 400ms; arrow sway 2.4s ease-in-out
motion.purpose: One gesture hint, once per session.

motion.name: load-card
motion.value: bar steps 500ms var(--ease) to 33% / 67% / 100%; card fades 600ms ease
motion.purpose: Load progress on the green field.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; era dip display: none; idle fade off
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce makes every change instant.

components.name: Placard
components.description: The standard control: a small green painted board with a cream keyline. Turns cream when pressed or open.
components.css: .ds-placard { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 1px 15px 0; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #1e4a33; color: #e7ece3; font: 700 13.5px/1 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-stretch: 82%; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1e4a33, inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(231, 236, 227, 0.5), 0 1px 0 rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.5), 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.7); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-placard:hover { background: #28603f; } .ds-placard:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-placard[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #e7ece3; color: #123524; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #e7ece3, inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(18, 53, 36, 0.45); } .ds-placard[aria-pressed='true']:hover { background: #f4f7f1; } .ds-placard:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2c46d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Era title
components.description: The year in fixed digit cells with the era name and span beside it. Sits on the scrim.

components.css: .ds-era { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; padding: 28px 20px 18px; background: rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.72); color: #e7ece3; } .ds-era-year { display: flex; font: 900 72px/0.8 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-stretch: 68%; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; text-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.5); } .ds-era-year > span { display: block; width: 0.5em; text-align: center; } .ds-era-words { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; padding-bottom: 1px; } .ds-era-label { font: 700 22px/1.12 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-era-span { font: 600 13px/1.2 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 84%; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Route line
components.description: True-scale line with year stops and a gold marker. The current stop is a cream chip.
components.css: .ds-route { position: relative; height: 72px; margin: 14px 22px 0; background: transparent; } .ds-route::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -14px -22px 0; background: rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.72); } .ds-route-line { position: absolute; left: -22px; right: -22px; top: 0; height: 2px; background: rgba(231, 236, 227, 0.66); } .ds-route-progress { position: absolute; left: -22px; top: 0; width: calc(78% + 22px); height: 2px; background: #e7ece3; } .ds-route-knob { position: absolute; top: -7px; left: 78%; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-left: -8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f2c46d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.6), 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.5); cursor: grab; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-route-knob:hover { transform: scale(1.15); } .ds-route-stop { position: absolute; top: 10px; min-height: 48px; min-width: 44px; padding: 6px 0 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #e7ece3; font: 800 16px/1 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-stretch: 72%; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; } .ds-route-stop span { display: block; padding: 7px 6px 6px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-route-stop:hover span { background: rgba(231, 236, 227, 0.16); } .ds-route-stop:active span { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-route-stop[aria-current='true'] span { background: #e7ece3; color: #123524; } .ds-route-stop:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-route-stop:focus-visible span { outline: 2px solid #f2c46d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: One gesture hint, once per session. Leaves on the first drag.

components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px 9px; border-radius: 3px; background: #1e4a33; color: #e7ece3; font: 700 12.5px/1 'Archivo', 'Arial Narrow', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-stretch: 84%; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1e4a33, inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(231, 236, 227, 0.5), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(8, 20, 14, 0.7); } .ds-hint svg { flex: none; animation: ds-hint-sway 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-hint-sway { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-3px); } 50% { transform: translateX(3px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hint svg { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The overlay is the ferry landing's painted signage, hung over a full-window 3D scene. It has a station sign, small painted placards, a route line with year stops, and one cream facts board. The scene is the subject. The overlay names the year, offers the controls, and steps back.

Every colour comes from the owner's approved sign vector (docs/assets/el-ancon-de-loiza-sign.svg): bottle green, sign cream, painted ochre. Sun gold marks focus and the route marker. One type family, Archivo, speaks in two voices: narrow and heavy for signs and years, normal width for reading.

Objects are opaque paint, not glass. Text that sits straight on the scene gets a green-black scrim so it reads on any sky. This system applies to the HTML overlay only (src/styles.css, src/ui/*, the load card in index.html, public/404.html). The 3D scene has its own art direction.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed scene; controls sit at the four corners and the bottom edge.
Painted placards with an inner cream keyline. Radii are 2–4px.
Years are heavy narrow numerals in fixed digit cells.
State changes are colour cuts with a small lift-and-settle, never a glide.
One green field covers loading, era changes, the no-WebGL fallback and the 404 page.

rules.name: The Sign Palette Rule
rules.body: --green, --cream and --ochre must equal fills in the sign vector. A unit test fails if they drift.

rules.name: The One Ochre Rule
rules.body: Ochre as a ground appears once: the Facts placard. It marks the way to the sourced content.

rules.name: The Gold Is Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Gold marks focus, the route marker and selection. It is never a placard ground or a text colour on the scene.

rules.name: The Fixed Cell Rule
rules.body: Each digit of a year sits in a cell 0.5em wide with tabular-nums lining-nums. A digit changes in place. Nothing slides sideways.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Narrow width means "this is painted on a sign": years, labels, stamps. Normal width means "read this": era names, facts, sources. Do not set sentences in the sign voice.

rules.name: The Own Ground Rule
rules.body: A placard, menu or board carries its own opaque ground and needs no scrim. Only bare text on the scene uses the scrim.

rules.name: The Keyline Rule
rules.body: Every placard has a 1px inner line, inset 2px, in the opposite sign colour at about half strength. It is drawn with inset box-shadow, not a border.

dos: Do take colours from the :root tokens. Green, cream and ochre must match the sign vector.
Do give every control its own opaque ground: green placard, cream when chosen.
Do put bare text on the scene inside the scrim zone, in cream. Small text needs 4.5:1 and large text 3:1 against the scrim over a white sky; contrast.test.ts checks this.
Do use the gold 2px outline with 2px offset for focus on every control. Links on the cream board use a green outline.
Do set years in the sign voice at weight 900 with tabular lining numerals in fixed cells.
Do show state with a colour cut plus settle-press.
Do keep every fact's sources on the line beside it, and stamp inferred facts.
Do keep the map credit visible and keyboard-reachable; it is a licence requirement.
Do offset bottom objects with --rail-h, --stack and --lift so they clear the route line at every width.
Do announce era changes and the Recenter button through the polite live regions, and keep the skip link.
donts: Don't use glass: no backdrop-filter, no blurred or translucent panels.
Don't add a second accent colour. Ochre is the only accent ground, and only on Facts.
Don't use rounded pills. Radii are 2–4px; only the route marker and stop dots are round.
Don't add a second panel. The facts board is the only one.
Don't use gradients on objects. The only gradients are the green field, the scrim, and edge fade masks.
Don't fade or glide a state colour, and don't slide digits sideways.
Don't shrink the route line on phones; scroll it and centre the chosen stop.
Don't fade the placards on touch devices; a hidden button could take the tap meant to wake it.
Don't add a second typeface or set sentences in the narrow sign voice.
Don't let any motion run under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
